raw_text: Multiple reports coming in about Eritrean forces still operating in Tigray despite the ceasefire. Satellite images and ground reports seem to confirm this. Has anyone seen independent verification from international monitors? The UN seems to be very quiet on this issue. Some analysts are questioning whether the Pretoria agreement is being enforced at all.
